title: Boila plugin entry
description: Frontmatter shape for a single plugin entry. Each .mdx file under apps/web/content/plugins/ must validate against this schema. The compiled registry.json is the public contract consumed by the npx @boila/cli CLI.

slug.description: URL slug. Must match the filename (sans .mdx) and the URL path /plugins/<slug>.

description.description: One-line pitch. Used on listing cards and the detail page lead.

category.description: Closed enum used to group plugins in the /plugins index.

compatibleStacks.description: Stack slugs the plugin targets. Empty means stack-agnostic. Used to filter compatible boilerplates.

requires.description: Plugin slugs that must be present. The CLI will auto-select prerequisites.

conflicts.description: Plugin slugs that are mutually exclusive with this one. The CLI warns and refuses to scaffold both.

env.description: Environment variable names this plugin needs. Consolidated into .env.example at scaffold time.

repo.description: Git repository URL holding the plugin sources.

branch.description: Branch to clone. Defaults to main.

subdir.description: Subdirectory inside the repo. Contents are dropped into the scaffolded project as-is.

source.description: Where the plugin files live. The CLI uses giget to clone the subdir into the scaffolded project.

postInstall.description: Optional command to run after the plugin is applied (e.g. 'pnpm db:push').

authors.description: GitHub handles of the plugin maintainers.

maintained.description: true if the plugin source is actively maintained (commit within ~6 months).

license.description: SPDX license identifier. Only permissive licenses are accepted.

addedAt.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the plugin was added to the registry.
